description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeys component, specifically testing the creation of key sessions within a media DRM context. It defines a test fixture class and two test cases: one for successful creation and one for failure due to system error.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysCreateKeySessionTest
classes.description: Test fixture class inheriting from MediaKeysTestBase, setting up media key creation and destruction for testing createKeySession functionality.

methods.name: RialtoServerMediaKeysCreateKeySessionTest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes media keys with a specific key system.

methods.name: ~RialtoServerMediaKeysCreateKeySessionTest
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up media keys.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test case verifying successful creation of a media key session and validation of the session ID.

methods.name: OcdmSystemFailure
methods.description: Test case verifying failure of createKeySession when the underlying system (ocdm) creation fails.
